name: Efecto Ringing de Bordes
algorithm: Edge Ringing — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method detects edge ringing artifacts for video forensic analysis:

1. **Gibbs Phenomenon Detección**: Sharp edges may exhibit oscillatory overshoot/undershoot (Gibbs phenomenon) from frequency-domain processing. The method profiles intensity around strong edges, looking for characteristic ringing patterns — alternating bright/dark fringes decaying with distance from the edge.

2. **Ringing Source Clasificación**: Different sources produce different ringing signatures: (a) JPEG/HEVC compression produces block-aligned ringing, (b) upscaling interpolation produces ringing at the interpolation kernel's cutoff frequency, (c) AI generation may produce ringing from the generator's convolutional architecture. The method classifies observed ringing to identify its source.

3. **Espacial Ringing Consistencia**: All regions of authentically processed video should show consistent ringing characteristics. The method compares ringing patterns between face and background regions — different ringing signatures indicate compositing, where the face underwent different processing than the background.

4. **Ringing Frecuencia Análisis**: The spatial frequency of ringing oscillations reveals the processing that caused them. The method measures ringing frequency at multiple edges throughout the image. Inconsistent ringing frequencies between regions indicate content from different processing pipelines.

5. **Temporal Ringing Seguimiento**: Ringing patterns at static edges should be temporally stable. The method tracks ringing characteristics across frames — AI generation may produce varying ringing artifacts as the generator processes each frame independently, while codec ringing remains consistent for static regions across frames within a GOP.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante edge ringing analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
